create_annotation_gesture_tracker: create an Annotation instance to track hand vertices and gesture labels for pose data
save_gestures_to_json: save hand gesture vertex data to a JSON file using the NumpyJSONEncoder for serialization
load_gestures_from_json: load previously saved gesture vertex data from a JSON file into the Annotation object
guess_annotations_match_gestures: match tracked hand vertices against known gestures and return the closest label by difference value
plot_hand_3d_visualization: plot hand vertex data in a 3D matplotlib axes with configurable drawing order and scaling
